label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/ssrf): alert-TP — resolved sink value is http://<user-hostname>/api opened via URL.openStream(): User-controlled param flows directly to host variable, which becomes part of the URL string passed to openStream(). While there is a pre-fetch DNS validation check (isNonPublicAddress(resolveHost(host))), this only blocks well-known non-public addresses (loopback, site-local, link-local, any-local). It does not protect against DNS rebinding attacks, IPv6 special addresses, or custom domains resolving to internal IPs. The separate DNS resolution followed by outbound fetch allows an attacker to craft requests targeting internal infrastructure through controlled domain names.

evidence.note: User input param assigned to host variable
DNS resolution performed but only blocks limited address types
Sink: user-controlled host embedded in URL string passed to openStream()
